ns2:section.sectionText: DANC 100 ? Intro to Contemporary Dance is an overview of major works, figures, and trends responsible for shaping dance as an evolving contemporary art form. Intended for non-dance majors, the course is comprised of lecture, viewing, discussion and experiential (studio participation) components. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
